en.title: The first Boeing 717 ever built still flies ten sectors a day in Hawaii
en.summary: Registration N488HA, line airframe MSN 55001, is the world's oldest surviving Boeing 717; a former Boeing testbed from 1998, it now flies Hawaiian Airlines interisland routes, completing ten sectors and about 4 hours 42 minutes airborne on October 9, with Hawaiian planning to replace its 717s with Boeing 737-800s from 2028.
body: In Hawaii, a piece of aviation history is still flying between the islands after nearly 30 years in service. Registration N488HA, line airframe MSN 55001, is the world's oldest surviving Boeing 717: technically the second 717 ever produced, but the first to enter regular service. Its history begins in 1998, when it flew as Boeing testbed N717XB, the platform used to certify the MD-95 derivative that was later rebranded as the 717. It later flew commercially in the Southern Hemisphere, operating for Australia's Impulse Airlines and QantasLink as VH-VQA and VH-NXF, before finding its permanent home in Hawaii, where it now flies for Hawaiian Airlines as N488HA, carrying the traditional Hawaiian bird name Puaiohi, after more than two decades in the island chain.

Simple Flying's tracker replay followed the aircraft through Friday, October 9, when it flew ten sectors in a single day. It left Honolulu's Daniel K. Inouye International Airport at 07:07 Hawaiian Standard Time as AS1013, a 21-minute hop to Lihue, and returned as AS1024 at 08:13; after another Lihue rotation it flew to Kahului as AS1096 at 12:43. In the evening it operated AS1120 from Lihue to Kailua-Kona, a 45-minute sector, then AS1157 back to Honolulu, and finished the day as AS1132, leaving Honolulu at 21:19 and reaching Hilo at 21:53 after a 35-minute hop. Most short sectors lasted about 21 to 27 minutes airborne, and across the ten sectors it accumulated about 4 hours and 42 minutes airborne and ten full pressurization cycles. The type suits the work: descended from the McDonnell Douglas DC-9 and MD-80 families, the 717 has a heavy-gauge aluminum fuselage and rugged landing gear, rear-mounted Rolls-Royce BR715 engines and built-in airstairs for fast turnarounds; AirInsight has reported Hawaiian's 717s flying up to 16 cycles a day.

Since the Alaska Air Group and Hawaiian Airlines merger, the interisland flights carry Alaska's AS flight numbers, though the cabin experience and ground operations remain rooted in Hawaiian island culture, and passengers from mainland North American gateways can connect onto 717 rotations on a single booking. The type's retirement is approaching: Delta, the world's largest 717 operator, is replacing its fleet with Airbus A220s, and Hawaiian plans to phase out its interisland 717s from 2028, moving those sectors to Boeing 737-800s, according to Business Traveller. The 717's departure will close the DC-9 bloodline, but a day of ten sectors from the oldest airframe shows why the type survived so long on punishing short-stage, high-cycle flying.

facts.claim: Using the Simple Flying Live Flight Tracker, registration N488HA was monitored through a 24-hour operating window, churning through ten distinct sectors in a single day.

The history of MSN 55001 begins in 1998 as Boeing's flight testbed registered as N717XB, as per AirFleets, serving as the foundational platform for certifying the MD-95 derivative before the program was rebranded as the 717; it is technically only the second ever produced, but the first to enter regular service.

The airframe operated for Australian carriers Impulse Airlines and Qantaslink under registrations VH-VQA and VH-NXF, and now flies for Hawaiian Airlines as N488HA with the traditional Hawaiian bird name Puaiohi, after more than two decades in Hawaii.

Monitoring registration N488HA through Friday, October 9, showed it departing Honolulu at 07:07 local Hawaiian Standard Time on flight AS1013 on a 21-minute hop to Lihue, returning as AS1024 at 08:13 HST, then flying to Kahului as AS1096 at 12:43 HST.

In the evening N488HA operated flight AS1120 from Lihue to Kailua-Kona with a 45-minute airborne duration, followed by the return sector AS1157 to Honolulu, and finished the day as flight AS1132, departing Honolulu at 21:19 HST and touching down in Hilo at 21:53 HST after a 35-minute hop; across all ten sectors it accumulated roughly 4 hours and 42 minutes of total airborne time and ten full pressurization cycles.

The 717 traces its lineage back to the McDonnell Douglas DC-9 and MD-80 families, features a heavy-gauge aluminum fuselage and robust landing gear, and is powered by twin rear-mounted Rolls-Royce BR715 turbofans; reporting from AirInsight has shown Hawaiian's 717s frequently operate up to 16 cycles a day.

After the merger between Alaska Air Group and Hawaiian Airlines, flight numbers transitioned to Alaska Airlines' AS prefix, while the cabin experience and local ground operations remain rooted in Hawaiian's island culture.

Hawaiian Airlines' interisland 717 operations are slated to be phased out starting in 2028, with the carrier planning to transition those sectors to Boeing 737-800s, as per Business Traveller, and Delta Air Lines is replacing its 717 fleet with Airbus A220 aircraft.

zh.title: 首架波音717服役近30年仍在夏威夷一天飛十班
zh.summary: 編號N488HA、生產序號MSN 55001的波音717是全球現存最老的717，1998年曾任波音試飛機，如今在夏威夷航空旗下飛島際航線；追蹤顯示它在10月9日一天飛了十個航段、累計約4小時42分鐘空中時間，夏威夷航空計畫自2028年起以737-800接替717。
body: 在夏威夷，一段重要的航空史仍在島嶼之間飛行：編號N488HA的波音717是全球現存最老的717，生產序號MSN 55001，技術上是第二架生產的717，卻是第一架投入定期服務的飛機。它的歷史可追溯至1998年，當時以N717XB的編號擔任波音試飛機，為MD-95衍生型認證提供平台，MD-95計畫隨後更名為717。此後它曾在南半球營運，依AirFleets、Airport-Data與Simple Flying飛機分析的記載，先後以VH-VQA與VH-NXF編號飛澳洲業者Impulse Airlines與QantasLink，最終落腳夏威夷，改掛N488HA編號並取名夏威夷鳥名Puaiohi，在夏威夷航空旗下服務逾20年。

追蹤數據顯示這架老飛機的日常節奏極為緊湊。根據Simple Flying追蹤器重播資料，10月9日它自檀香山丹尼爾·K·井上國際機場（HNL）於夏威夷標準時間07:07以AS1013航班出發，21分鐘後抵達利胡埃（LIH），隨即以AS1024航班於08:13返航；上午再飛一趟利胡埃往返，中午12:43以AS1096航班飛往卡胡盧伊（OGG）。傍晚再經利胡埃轉往凱盧阿-科納（KOA），AS1120航班空中時間45分鐘，返航後最後一班AS1132於21:19自檀香山出發，21:53抵達希洛（ITO）。多數短程航段空中時間約21至27分鐘，十個航段全天累計約4小時42分鐘，歷經十次完整增壓循環。設計上，717源自麥道DC-9與MD-80家族，採用厚規格鋁合金機身與特別堅固的起落架，兩具後置勞斯萊斯BR715發動機提供高起飛推力，機上內建登機梯可加快登機；據AirInsight報導，夏威夷航空的717每天最多可飛16個循環。

阿拉斯加航空集團與夏威夷航空合併後，島際航班的航班號已改用阿拉斯加航空的AS前綴，但客艙體驗與地面作業仍深植夏威夷島嶼文化，旅客可自北美本土航線無縫轉乘717島際航班。不過這款機型的退役時程已近：據Simple Flying分析，達美航空正以空中巴士A220逐步取代全球最大的717機隊；夏威夷航空則依Business Traveller的報導，計畫自2028年起逐步淘汰島際717，改以波音737-800執飛高密度短程航線。717退役將象徵DC-9血統的終結，但N488HA的每日十個航段證明，這款為高循環短程飛行而生的老飛機，至今仍能勝任夏威夷島際網絡的嚴苛節奏。
